title.label: Love the App, But Could Use Auto-Capitalization

content.label: I really like how you can customize just about everything you need, like the skins and the many sounds effects it has, for example. I also enjoy the emojicons that’s in the app. However, I feel like having the auto-capitalization that Apple has (or something similar) will greatly help users of the English keyboard as it would it make it more efficient for them.
